title: OpenMontage-planned Grok multi-angle shot factory
best_for: turning owner-approved villa or tour footage into a new 15-30 second reel assembled from five to eight independently accepted angles
using Grok CLI image cleanup and image-to-video as bounded shot workers while OpenMontage retains editorial and factual control
avoid_when: reuse rights, source identity, or material property facts are unresolved
the source cannot provide at least five distinct human-free angles after review
the requested result is a simple truthful recut that does not benefit from generated motion
the owner has not approved the Grok consumer-session generation allowance
a generated shot must be treated as evidence of an exact facility, view, condition, or availability
source_contract: Classify every URL as pattern reference or authorized production source before downloading
Record source URL, uploader, video ID, rights state, fetch time, local private path, and SHA-256
Review the complete source and extract at least two candidate frames for every intended angle
Reject any candidate containing a face, body, silhouette, reflection, or unremovable material ambiguity
Write a shot manifest before generation with angle ID, source timestamp, frame hash, visible facts, cleanup targets, invariants, story role, and target duration
Keep source downloads, extracted frames, provider session files, and generated media outside git
creative_contract: OpenMontage owns the story order, shot manifest, captions, narration, music plan, and final composition; Grok is a bounded per-shot transformation worker

Use Grok CLI consumer-session image_edit to remove only named people, source text, logos, or unwanted objects while preserving architecture, pool edges, furniture, materials, perspective, lighting, crop, and view
Approve each cleaned frame at full resolution before calling image_to_video
Generate one 3-5 second 720p motion sample per approved frame with one restrained camera move and one restrained natural motion
Generate shots sequentially; do not batch unreviewed angles or ask Grok to create the complete reel in one prompt
Require five to eight accepted angles such as arrival, living area, bedroom, bathroom, pool, dining area, view, and closing hero only when those facts exist in approved sources
Assemble only independently accepted shots through the proposal-approved OpenMontage composition runtime
Use immediate visual coverage, purposeful shot order, licensed music, optional truthful narration, sparse mobile-safe captions, and an explicit POC marker
qa_contract: Record Grok CLI version, reasoning model, consumer media tool name, exposed media model ID or not-exposed state, session ID, duration, resolution, latency, and output hash
Track image cleanup, motion generation, and final composition as three separate acceptance gates
Review every generated shot at start, 25 percent, 50 percent, 75 percent, and end plus full playback
Reject people, animals, text, logos, invented boats, landforms, buildings, facilities, furniture, views, geometry drift, implausible horizon movement, or material changes
Treat PASS_WITH_NOTES as FAIL whenever a note matches any hard rejection
Allow at most one corrected generation for an angle; replace or drop the angle after the second failure
Require at least five accepted shots from no more than ten motion attempts for the first full-reel proof
Run CRV and independent visual review on every accepted shot and on the assembled final
Compare accepted-shot yield, latency, generation allowance or cost, geometry fidelity, and final quality against the locked HappyHorse/Wan baseline
hard_rejections: Grok directly invents or assembles the whole reel without an approved OpenMontage shot manifest
a cleaned frame advances to motion before full-resolution review
an invented horizon object, facility, view, furniture item, or geometry change is dismissed as minor
a technical tool-capability PASS is reported as creative acceptance
more than ten motion attempts are used to obtain the first five accepted shots
an unavailable Grok surface silently falls back to another provider or a still animation
generated motion is represented as documentary evidence of the real operator or property
final composition begins with fewer than five accepted, source-grounded angles

canonical_artifacts.role: Grok CLI execution and independent-review harness
failed first audit and routing evidence
source cleanup and motion QA contract

notes: This is an experimental recipe, not a production default
Use pipeline_defs/hybrid.yaml, run OpenMontage preflight, and obtain owner approval before Grok media calls
Record the consumer-session allowance as unknown when the CLI does not expose per-generation cost
Present available Remotion and HyperFrames composition options before locking the final runtime
Do not promote until one complete five-to-eight-angle reel passes independent review

proof.disposition: Component capability proven; full multi-angle recipe not yet creatively accepted
proof.qa: Grok CLI image_edit passed on the corrective courtyard frame, while the corresponding I2V failed independent source-grounded QA because it introduced a horizon object and furniture drift
